purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/service routes, bounded anonymous access review, and evidence limits.
assessment: Coventry City Council has an official online planning map and property-search index. The council landing page was fetched successfully and linked to the current public interactive map host. A bounded anonymous map/API response containing safe parcel identifiers and geometry could not be verified: the linked host failed TLS certificate verification in the available client, and no certificate exception was authorized. HM Land Registry official pages describe index-map searches and paid/request-based registered-title polygon products, not an open citywide parcel endpoint. No parcel sample is retained.
registryAssessment: The official local council planning/property-search pages establish a local public mapping/procedure context, but not an evidenced local cadastral registry or open parcel-vector service. Therefore registryFound remains null.
safeFieldAllowlist: safe parcel or title identifier only if publicly exposed and non-personal

attempts.result: Official Coventry City Council planning-map page loaded; extracted linked interactive map URL and reviewed scope/use conditions.
Official council property-search index loaded; links to land charges, ownership checks, council-owned land and restrictive-covenant procedures; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint exposed.
Official council-maintained geography directory loaded; listed ward/statistical/general geography files, but no cadastral parcel layer.

Linked public interactive map could not be fetched by the available client because its certificate chain was not locally trusted. No TLS verification bypass or source-specific exception was authorized; no API/config/schema/geometry was inferred.
HM Land Registry official polygon guidance reviewed; service provides specific registered-title extents through request/paid products. No request was submitted and no unsafe fields were sought.
HM Land Registry index-map guidance reviewed; searches require a submitted address, plan, or Ordnance Survey reference. No search request was submitted.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No exact-point parcel containment test was completed. The WUP point was preserved exactly and was not shifted to force a hit; map-host TLS failure and request-based HMLR procedures are not evidence of citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: The linked council viewer's current JavaScript/configuration, service endpoints, CRS, native parcel identity, exact-point parcel, and citywide open coverage remain unverified. A future attempt may inspect the viewer from a trusted client or use an explicitly authorized, source-specific certificate exception; no such exception was available for this attempt.
